map.Kopija serveryje daroma kas minutę, kai: A copy is saved on the server every minute while something changes. When restoring, the current state is saved too, so a restore can be undone. A mistake in one category is easier to fix in its control: “Undo” or “Reset…”.
map.Atidarykite tatamio ekraną antrame monit: Open the tatami screen on a second monitor or TV (in the browser, F11 - full screen). It shows the bout, scores, clock and who is next.
map.Atidarykite planšetėje prie apdovanojimų: Open it on a tablet at the awards. An age group turns green when all its categories (both kata and kumite) are finished and sent. After awarding, the person taps “Finish”. The link is secret - give it only to the person running the awards.
map.Tėvai ir kiti klubai telefone mato, kas: Parents and other clubs see on their phones what is happening on each tatami, who is next and the results.
map.Kitų klubų treneriai ir Karatekos tėvai: Coaches of other clubs and Karateka parents fill in: club, name, surname, birth year, gender, belt, phone. You see them in the “Participants” tab and add them with one button.

map.Federacija vienija klubus, rengia varžyb: The federation unites clubs, organises competitions and seminars, trains referees and looks after a common grading syllabus.
map.Jūsų sportininkai dalyvauja federacijos: Your athletes take part in federation competitions, coaches in seminars, referees get qualified and students take gradings by one syllabus.
map.Vienija tradicinio karatė klubus Lietuvo: Unites traditional karate clubs in Lithuania: competitions, referees, gradings, national team.
map.Raskite tradicinio karatė klubą savo mie: Find a traditional karate club in your city. All clubs train by the same grading syllabus and take part in federation competitions.
map.Pavyzdys: sąrašas paimtas iš Budo Cup 20: Example: the list is taken from Budo Cup 2026 participants. Denis will confirm which clubs are LTKF members, their cities and contacts.
The map shows clubs with an address. Others will appear when clubs add their addresses.
map.Federacijos nariu gali tapti kiekvienas: Any traditional karate club in Lithuania can become a federation member.
map.Varžybos, seminarai, teisėjų mokymai ir: Competitions, seminars, referee training and gradings for all federation clubs.
map.Varžybos su žyme „Iš varžybų sistemos“ a: Competitions marked “From the competition system” arrive automatically – no need to enter them twice.
map.Geros varžybos prasideda nuo teisėjų. Fe: Good competitions start with referees. The federation trains, tests and upgrades them.
map.Baigė seminarą, teisėjauja kartu su paty: Completed the seminar, referees together with an experienced referee.
map.Išlaikė testą, teisėjauja vaikų ir jauni: Passed the test, referees children's and youth categories.
map.Teisėjauja visose kategorijose, gali būt: Referees all categories, can be the tatami chief referee.
map.Vyriausiasis varžybų teisėjas, veda semi: Chief referee of competitions, leads seminars.
map.Lygiai – pavyzdys. Tikrą tvarką patvirti: Levels – an example. The referee commission will approve the real order.
No seminars planned at the moment.
map.Treniruotės testą jau naudoja Karate Ate: Karate Ateitis referees already use the practice test. The federation can open it to referees of all clubs.
map.Lietuvos tradicinio karatė federacija vi: The Lithuanian Traditional Karate Federation unites clubs that cherish traditional karate: technique, discipline and respect.
map.[Kada ir kas įkūrė federaciją, kiek klub: [When and by whom the federation was founded, how many clubs at the start, key achievements. Denis will write the text.]
map.Federacija priklauso visiems jos klubams: The federation belongs to all its clubs. Every club has a vote, and its athletes have equal conditions at competitions.
map.Sportininkai dalyvauja federacijos varžy: Athletes take part in federation competitions and the championship, registration is via the competition system.
map.Klubo teisėjai mokosi seminaruose ir gau: The club's referees learn at seminars and get a national qualification.
map.Viena kyu ir dan egzaminų programa visoj: One kyu and dan grading syllabus across Lithuania.
map.Geriausi sportininkai atrenkami į tarpta: The best athletes are selected for international competitions.
Clubs using a member system (e.g. karateka.lt) register athletes straight from their member list. Only the necessary data is passed to the competition: name, surname, date of birth, gender, belt, club.
map.Įstatai, varžybų taisyklės, nuostatai ir: Statutes, competition rules, regulations and grading syllabus in one place.
map.Vietos kiekvienoje kategorijoje ir klubų: Places in every category and club medal tables.
map.Vaikų rezultatuose rodomas vardas ir pav: Children's results show the first name and the first letter of the surname. Whether to show the full surname is the federation's decision.
